test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What is the Technology & Innovation Sub-Mission (TISM), launched in 2024 as a part of PMAY-U 2.0, related to?

options.text: It is intended to facilitate digitisation of urban housing records and streamline approval processes for construction permits.
It is focused on promoting green building techniques and energy-efficient housing designs across geo-climatic regions.
It is meant to promote skill certification and labour reforms in the real estate sector through training schemes.
It is introduced to provide housing loans to first-time homebuyers with dynamic interest rates based on income levels.

solution:
The Correct answer is __**It is focused on promoting green building techniques and energy-efficient housing designs across geo-climatic regions.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Technology & Innovation Sub-Mission (TISM)** is a critical component of the **PMAY-U (Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban) 2.0**, launched in **2024**.
 
• Its primary goal is to promote the adoption of **green building techniques** and energy-efficient housing designs&
